concept: Control Tower: landing zone with guardrails and centralized logging
tests: Which service automatically sets up and governs a multi-account environment per best practices.
expected: AWS Control Tower — landing zone, guardrails (SCP/Config), centralized logging, Account Factory. Triggers: "multi-account environments", "guardrails", "centralized logging", "landing zone".
why_not: CloudFormation StackSets deploy templates but don't provide a managed landing zone; Systems Manager — operations within accounts; OpsWorks — application configuration management.
